title: Custom RichTextEffects receive extra calls to _process_custom_fx() when they are at the end of RichTextLabel
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.beta5.official [bbd3f43b5], v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f], v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf], v4.8.dev7.official [c971f93e7]
- Not reproducible in: v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4], v4.7.beta2.official [777579205], v4.7.beta3.official [860821708], v4.7.beta4.official [dff2b9bb6]

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable.mono (ed1daf0bf) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 14 Sep 2026 22:41:30 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (radeonsi, navi22, ACO, DRM 3.64, 7.2.6-arch2-1) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-10400F CPU @ 2.90GHz (12 threads) - 31.26 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When a RichTextLabel ends with a custom RichTextEffect, the RichTextEffect's ``_process_custom_fx()`` method will be called one or more extra times after the actual content is processed. This happens both when the ``text`` property is set to something like ``[custom]abc[/custom]`` and when the RichTextLabel is modified with calls to ``push_*()``  and ``append_text()``.

### Steps to reproduce

In the main scene of the MRP there is a RichTextLabel with the content ``[custom]abc[/custom] [custom]def[/custom]``. The ``[custom]`` tag is hooked to a custom RichTextEffect that displays some relevant information from CharFXTransform. If you start the MRP and look in the console, you will see its output. In 4.7.2 it should be something like the following (repeating each frame):

```
processed character with relative index 0, glyph flags 1, glyph index 68, origin (547.0, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 1, glyph flags 1, glyph index 69, origin (556.2812, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 2, glyph flags 1, glyph index 70, origin (566.25, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 0, glyph flags 1, glyph index 71, origin (578.3594, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 1, glyph flags 1, glyph index 72, origin (588.3281, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 2, glyph flags 1, glyph index 73, origin (597.5469, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 2, glyph flags 44, glyph index 0, origin (603.3438, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 3, glyph flags 41, glyph index 0, origin (603.3438, 330.5)
```

The first six lines are expected output, processing the ``abc`` and ``def`` strings from the label. The next two lines represent erroneous calls to ``_process_custom_fx()``. If you modify the content of the RichTextLabel by adding any character at the end, these extra lines vanish. 

``glyph_flags`` 44 corresponds to `` GRAPHEME_IS_BREAK_SOFT | GRAPHEME_IS_SPACE | GRAPHEME_IS_VIRTUAL`` and 41 corresponds to ``GRAPHEME_IS_BREAK_SOFT | GRAPHEME_IS_SPACE | GRAPHEME_IS_VALID``.

In 4.8.dev7, the output is different but still wrong: 

```
processed character with relative index 0, glyph flags 1, glyph index 68, origin (547, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 1, glyph flags 1, glyph index 69, origin (556.28125, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 2, glyph flags 1, glyph index 70, origin (566.25, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 0, glyph flags 1, glyph index 71, origin (578.3594, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 1, glyph flags 1, glyph index 72, origin (588.3281, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 2, glyph flags 1, glyph index 73, origin (597.5469, 330.5)
processed character with relative index 3, glyph flags 41, glyph index 0, origin (603.34375, 330.5)
```

In v4.7.beta4.official and earlier, the output is as expected, only the first six lines.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33227045/mrp.zip)
